en: Black‑and‑white view down a narrow cobbled lane leading to an arched gate in an old masonry complex dominated by a tall round tower with a domed roof and small lantern on top. Leafless tree branches frame the scene on the left, and simple plastered houses with tiled roofs line the right side. On the left front side there is a wooden fence with a signboard projecting over the lane. The overall appearance suggests an early‑20th‑century European town scene focused on a historic tower and gateway.
